text:
Asha V (Finance): Heads-up: Merchantly invoice M-339 failed auto-pay at 08:03. Stripe decline_code: card_declined / do_not_honor. Thoughts?
Tom H (BillingOps): Pulling record. Card ends 3309, exp 04/27. No fallback method. Customer is on annual prepay but this invoice is for add-ons.
Riley C (CS): I texted their AP; theysaid travel and can't access corporate card portal until Monday. They asked if we can accept a same-day wire or provide ACH details.
payments-bot: Stripe event: {"type":"payment_intent.payment_failed","code":"do_not_honor","amount":"60000"} posted.
Tom H (BillingOps): Suggest: 1) schedule 2 retries (24h), 2) send secure one-time pay link, 3) offer wire/ACH via encrypted email, 4) allow 48h grace before restricting usage.
Asha V (Finance): Approve 48h grace for now. Tom, set retries and flag invoice M-339 as "pending - retry scheduled". Riley, send secure wire template and ask for proof of wire/remittance.
Riley C (CS): Will do. I'll cc billing and request ETA. Also asked if they'd like us to attempt a manual retry after they update the card.
Tom H (BillingOps): Done: retries scheduled, invoice labeled, internal note: "customer requested wire; allow 48h grace".
Asha V (Finance): If no payment in 48h escalate to me. Don't paste routing or account numbers in channel. Use secure email.
Riley C (CS): Update: AP replied - will initiate wire today; ETA 2 business days. I sent secure instructions and requested remittance.
Tom H (BillingOps): Noted. Marking invoice as wire-pending and monitoring. Closing thread until funds clear.
